episode.subject_description: Bicycle pump, the general type of air pump designed for inflating bicycle tires. The target is the complete pump device, not the bicycle, a tire, the air it moves, or an individual pump component. Both manual and electric bicycle pumps are included. No particular brand, model, size, or individual device is specified.
